target.statement: TPP (Token-Pool Precision, |P∩D|/|P|) for Qwen-7B on the GSM8K math domain = 0.77
target.table_ref: Table 1, row Qwen-7B, column TPP, Math domain

compute.basis: Requires downloading Qwen-7B (~15GB), generating 200 GSM8K traces with greedy decoding, computing HSIC-based MI over 512-dim hidden states and DTR via layer-wise JSD, then Tukey IQR peak detection; feasible on CPU but slow (hours), and the exact TPP value depends on undocumented implementation details (HSIC subsample, RMSNorm placement, settling threshold).

blockers: Code repo may not include exact configs/scripts for the Qwen-7B math TPP cell
HSIC bandwidth calibration and 512-dim subsample details are only partially specified
DTR settling threshold τ=0.5 and α=0.85 are given but per-architecture JSD scale differences may affect reproduction
No GPU means 7B model inference on CPU is slow but possible
title: Integrated and Cross-Architecture Interpretation of LLM Reasoning
